title: Ball Wide Mouth Pint Mason Jars with Lids & Bands | 16-oz | 2-Pack
description:
About this item
Ball Wide Mouth Pint Mason Jars with Lids & Bands | 16-oz | 2-Pack
reviews_5s:
Perfect jars! I did not buy them to make jams or canneds but to use them with a machine to clean the parts of watches! Not having this type of jars in France, I ordered them in the USA. Perfectly packaged and protected, they are in perfect condition and are perfectly suitable in size and diameter for the machine: thank you!The quality is good. Good value for your money. Also doesn’t leak.Everyday juicing.Listen, I don’t usually write reviews, but these Ball Wide Mouth Pint Mason Jars have changed my life. Before these jars, my pickles were homeless, my iced coffee was shamefully drinking out of a regular cup, and my sourdough starter looked at me like I had failed it. But now? Now I am a person of culture.

These jars can do it all! Need a hipster drinking glass to convince people you care about “artisanal beverages”? Done. Want a sturdy container for your secret BBQ sauce recipe? Boom. Need a place to store the bolts and screws you swear you’ll organize one day? Say no more.

The wide mouth is a game-changer. Ever tried shoving a spoon into a regular jar to get the last bit of almond butter? That’s the struggle of peasants. With these jars, I can scoop with reckless abandon. No almond butter left behind.

And let's talk durability. I dropped one (by accident, not out of scientific curiosity), and it just sat there like, "Is that all you've got?" Meanwhile, my regular drinking glasses tremble in fear.

If these jars had arms, they would cradle me gently and tell me everything is going to be okay. But they don’t have arms, because they’re jars. Buy them anyway.I love these cute little jars. I purchasedthem for my my overnight oats and they work out great.
The jars are packaged to protect and they did a great job doing so.
The jars are strong and sturdy as are the tops. They live up to the name.I wanted to start making my own salad dressing, so I wanted a big jar with a wide mouth. I only need two, so this was perfect. Packaging was secure.What can I say? Ball mason jars, solid with 2 piece lids excellent as expected.Too expensiveGoodPerfect size. Nicely packed for delivery!
reviews_1s: The jars are fine but I mistakenly thought I was getting 2 cases for $13, not 2 individual jars! What a rip off price. The lids are also difficult to screw on but alas they do fit if you try hard enough. Just too much trouble to return since they arrived packaged in 4 bubble wrap mailing pouches inside another mailing pouch instead of a box. Crazy.Terrible packaging. Came stuffed in other USPS Mail envelopes. They are using USPS envelopes from like a USPS office I guess so they don’t need to pay for packaging. It is very odd. Also, terrible customer service experience with the issue I encountered. Seller was dismissive. Avoid.2 jars for the price of 12! Beware!arrived completely shattered! so dangerous to open a box of shattered glassI mistakenly assumed that I was getting a dozen pint size jars. I only got two. That is what the description said but I didn’t read it good enough. What a rip off!Was not happy. These are not widemouth jars. These are regular regular size will be returning.Nothing wrong with them. I just thought I was getting a dozen for that price and I was disappointed to get only 2. My fault for reading the picture instead of the words.The fact that I thought I had ordered 12 jars and not just 2! When I looked at it it said 12. Never again! Not even wide mouth jars! It's not even worth the gas to return them!Arrived broken but very easy to returnI must have not read it right. Never even dreamed 10 dollars was for 2 jars. NOT HAPPY
